content.cssRule:
display: inline-flex
align-items: center
gap: var(--space-1)
padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-3)
border-radius: var(--radius-full)
font-family: var(--font-sans)
font-size: var(--font-size-xs)
font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold)
letter-spacing: -0.01em
border: 1px solid transparent
white-space: nowrap
line-height: 1.5
position: relative
overflow: hidden
user-select: none
backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
content.description:
Chips are standalone semantic labels used inline within content to represent
  a category, status, or filter (e.g. "Payment", "Transfer", "Partial").

  Unlike .badge — which annotates other elements (counters, overlays, dots) —
  a chip is always descriptive and self-contained.

  Color tokens are defined in 00-config/03-theme.css under "Chip component tokens".

  Modifiers:
    .chip-solid     — filled background (vibrant, high-contrast)
    .chip-outline   — transparent background, colored border only
    .chip-s / .chip-l — size variants
    .bgg            — gradient background (combine with any variant)
    .shadow         — colored drop-shadow matching the chip hue
    .lit            — inner light effect (highlight at top + inset border glow)

  Modifier combinations are fully supported:
    .chip-solid.bgg.lit.shadow.chip-success   → maximum premium effect

content.cssRule:
content: ""
position: absolute
inset: 0
border-radius: inherit
background: linear-gradient(
        180deg,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22) 0%,
        rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.00) 55%
    )
pointer-events: none
content.description:
Simulates an inner light source: a semi-transparent highlight gradient
  from the top edge + an inset border glow at the bottom.
  Stronger on solid chips.
